description: Sumo QA — a senior-QA-shaped MCP server for pre-coding QA planning, TDD scaffolding, mutation-testing follow-up, code review, and test-data discovery.
long_description:
Sumo QA packages a senior QA engineer's working discipline as an MCP server with a bundled skills library. It drives the QA loop end to end: analyze the repository to understand what it does, map named risks to the tests and evidence that would catch them, decide a grounded test approach, then do the work: test plans, TDD scaffolding, mutation-testing follow-up, test-data discovery, and pre-merge diff review.

Every recommendation cites a curated QA catalogue of principles, techniques, classifications, and approaches instead of improvised advice, so guidance stays consistent across hosts and models. It ships as a standard stdio MCP server: install with pip, wire it into a supported host with one command, and verify the setup with the bundled doctor.
name: sumo-qa
short_description: A QA-native MCP server and skills library: analyze a repo, map risks to tests and evidence, plan and scaffold tests, strengthen weak suites, and review diffs before merge with senior-QA discipline.
